purpose: Demonstrates that the generic OpenAI-compatible binding is real and automated: the workflow activates on n8n 2.6.4 and its agent nodes issue calls to the base URL configured in reviewer/.env, with no credential wiring in the n8n UI.
endpoint_used: https://endpoint.invalid/v1  (RFC 6761 reserved TLD; deliberately unresolvable negative control)
api_key_used: negative-control-no-such-key  (not a credential; no real key was used at any point)
workflow_activation: succeeded; n8n logged 'Activated workflow "CAPRA Reviewer Route (admissions, openai-compatible)"' with no node type version error
boundary: No live OpenAI-compatible endpoint or API credential was available, so NO end-to-end model execution is claimed. What is established: node resolution, activation, credential import, credential binding, and an outbound call to the configured base URL. What is not established: any model response, any stage output produced by a hosted model.
